decision: 5 second time penalty imposed after the Sprint. (5 seconds added to elapsed Sprint time) Reason The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The car left the track on four (4) occasions without justifiable reason.
fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
